description: List the organizations a user belongs to, including their role and permissions in each. Returns newest memberships first with offset pagination and a total count. The user must belong to the selected application instance. Organization and membership private metadata are never returned.

instance.description: Instance to target: "development", "production", or a full instance ID (ins_…).

user_id.description: ID of the user in the selected instance.

name: list_user_organization_memberships
title: List user organization memberships
